acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a properly constructed custom tiny home is designed for year-round living, including in Oceanside's climate. The design can be optimized to take advantage of Oceanside's mild climate, incorporating features like ample natural light and ventilation. We focus on durability and energy efficiency for all-season occupancy.
